text:
marco: heads-up: the Console quota tile is showing different numbers than billing for some tenants. digging in, it looks like quota bucketing changed last quarter (per-route -> per-model+route) but the SDKs still send the old attribution header. can we align?

Tess: oof. which header? and why didn't this show up in staging?

marco: SDKs are still sending `X-Redwood-Quota-Key: tenant/<id>` while runtime expects `X-RW-Quota-Bucket: tenant/<id>/route/<name>/model/<id>` for accurate aggregation. backend accepts both but billing uses the new bucket.

alicia: product impact: customers see mismatch in Console vs invoice, that's a support fire. we need a quick mitigation (display warning) + migration plan.

sam: runtime notes: we made the bucket finer to reflect unit economics (some models cost more). accepting old header buckets everything under tenant-default which skews per-route dashboards.

pj: SDK compatibility: changing header format is a breaking change if we require it. but we can support both formats for 3 months. propose: SDKs add new header while preserving old one for fallback. also provide a library helper to compute the bucket.

zara: ops: recommend we add a telemetry tag `quota.bucket_version` to all events so we can measure adoption and roll back if needed. also rate-limit the telemetry to avoid noise.

marco: short-term mitigation: Console should show a small banner for tenants with >5% variance between Console quota tile and billing. longer-term: force clients to send full bucket.

Tess: UX: banner is fine. also add a CTA to show "how to upgrade SDKs". we should include sample code for python/ts/go.

alicia: legal/billing: we need to communicate that billing uses model-aware buckets; will coordinate with billing ops for a customer notice.

sam: telemetry plan: emit `quota.attribution` event when we map a request to a bucket. fields: `bucket_key`, `method` (header|server), `resolved_model`, `route`. sample 0.5% by default. add `bucket_version` tag (v1=v1-tenant, v2=v2-model).

pj: SDK change sketch (all SDKs will ship similar helper):

```
// TS SDK
const bucket = computeQuotaBucket({ tenantId, route, modelId });
headers['X-RW-Quota-Bucket'] = bucket;
headers['X-Redwood-Quota-Key'] = `tenant/${tenantId}`; // fallback
```

```
# Python SDK
client.set_quota_bucket(tenant_id, route='chat', model_id='open-v2');
```

pj: we'll add opt-in env var `RW_QUOTA_STRICT=true` that flips off sending the fallback header so advanced users can test. default: strict=false.

marco: is header name final? `X-RW-Quota-Bucket` shorter is nice. keep `X-Redwood-Quota-Key` as legacy.

zara: add an event `quota.bucket_mismatch` for when runtime sees legacy header but billing expects new. helps triage.

Tess: Console tile work: add a new small panel that compares `inbound_bucket_pct(v1)` vs `inbound_bucket_pct(v2)` and shows top routes affected. also a telemetry breakdown by SDK-lang.

alicia: communications: draft customer note saying "we will migrate quota attribution; update SDKs by June 15 to avoid mismatches". also prepare support playbook.

pj: CI: i'll add `sdk-quota-compat` job that runs against staging runtime verifying both headers produce same charge mapping for a set of canonical routes. devex-bot: please create job.

devex-bot: CI job created: `sdk-quota-compat` (owner: pj). triggers on sdk PRs, runs against `staging/quota-lookup`.

sam: rollout timeline suggestion: 2 weeks for SDK patches in patch releases (non-breaking), then a 6-week opt-in period with telemetry, then flip `RW_QUOTA_STRICT=true` default in 2 months.

pj: SDK release notes: highlight code snippets, env var, and a migration checklist. also note go/ts header-casing caveat (Go http library canonicalizes header keys).

marco: important: header-casing bug — Go clients set `X-Rw-Quota-Bucket` by default (net/http) vs `X-RW-Quota-Bucket` we expect. runtime lowercases headers, but some logging/metric agents are case-sensitive. pj please ensure SDK sets header using canonicalization helpers.

pj: noted. we'll add tests for header canonicalization in Go/TS/Python.

zara: ops follow-up: when we flip strict mode, let's run a shadow charge computation for 48h and compare diffs. will create a runbook.

Tess: UX follow-up: i'll mock the Console banner + upgrade CTA, will post screenshots. also add a mini-guided migration for in-console SDK download.

alicia: legal: get billing sign-off on notice wording.

marco: action items summarized:
- pj: implement header helper in SDKs + CI job (owner)
- sam: telemetry events + sampling plan (owner)
- tess: Console banner + comparison tile mockups (owner)
- zara: shadow charge runbook + ops checklist (owner)
- alicia: customer comms + billing sign-off (owner)

pj: i'll open PRs today for TS + Python. estimate 1 sprint for go patch due to header canonicalization tests.

marco: thanks. ping me for reviews. leaving thread open for +1s and any other concerns.
